response.sql: WITH total_recs AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount > 489) SELECT sf.zoneref as site_code, s.entrystat as access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) as avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_recs) as share_percent FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat HAVING (SELECT total FROM total_recs) > 0 ORDER BY share_percent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
